strings.key: C-C-CRAZY!!! Kureiji Ollie here!!!!
strings.value: 疯-疯-疯！！！克蕾西·奥莉登场！！！！

strings.key: Let's get ready to- Wait, who are you??
strings.value: 准备开——等等，你是谁？？

strings.key: Part time warehouse organizer? Really? I thought you were gonna be some big shot higherup...
strings.value: 兼职仓库整理员？真的吗？我还以为你会是什么大人物呢……

strings.key: Well, that doesn't matter now! Holofes is only two weeks away, and we're under attack!!
strings.value: 不过现在那些都不重要了！距离 HoloFes 只剩两周，而我们正遭受攻击！！

strings.key: A bunch of weird robots that look like hololive members are walking in here and breaking all our stuff!!
strings.value: 一群长得像 hololive 成员的奇怪机器人闯了进来，把我们的东西全都砸坏了！！

strings.key: Luckily, you've got a big pile of holodoll™ hololive figurines with you.
strings.value: 幸运的是，你身边有一大堆 holodoll™ hololive 手办。

strings.key: And with the energy of the fans' CHEER, they'll come to life to protect us!!
strings.value: 只要有了粉丝们 CHEER 的能量，它们就会活过来保护我们！！

strings.key: It's up to you to place them on the field to stop the robots from getting through!
strings.value: 就靠你把它们放到场上，阻止机器人突破了！

strings.key: You can do it, I believe in you! Good luck!!
strings.value: 你可以的，我相信你！加油！！

strings.key: THEY'RE IN THE CONCERT HALL!!
strings.value: 它们冲进音乐厅了！！

strings.key: Gosh, that sure is a lot of them...
strings.value: 天哪，数量真多啊……

strings.key: There's at least... six!
strings.value: 至少也有……六只！

strings.key: Luckily, this concert hall has loads of CHEER energy leftover from previous holofes!
strings.value: 幸运的是，这座音乐厅还残留着往届 HoloFes 的大量 CHEER 能量！

strings.key: Which means you won't need to spend CHEER to place holodolls!
strings.value: 也就是说，你放置 holodoll 不需要消耗 CHEER！

strings.key: We'll be sending them to you as fast as we can, so let's show them who's boss!!
strings.value: 我们会尽快把它们送过来，让他们瞧瞧我们的厉害！！

strings.key: Wow, you found a new type of holodoll!! And it's ME!!!!!!!!
strings.value: 哇，你发现了新型 holodoll！！而且是我！！！！！！！

strings.key: It seems as though somehow, each holodoll behaves in its own unique way, based on the original hololive member.
strings.value: 看来每一个 holodoll 都会以自己独特的方式行动，这取决于它对应的 hololive 成员。

strings.key: My holodoll for example is always cheering for hololive, and it even pops out some CHEER energy once in a while!
strings.value: 比如我的 holodoll 就一直在为 hololive 应援，偶尔还会冒出一些 CHEER 能量！

strings.key: Does this mean I've been simping too much and should cut back a bit? Uh, maybe..
strings.value: 难道是因为我沉迷得太过火，该收敛一点了吗？呃，也许吧……

strings.key: But it also means it'll give you more CHEER energy so you can place even more holodolls!
strings.value: 不过这也意味着它会给你更多 CHEER 能量，让你能放置更多 holodoll！

strings.key: Try to place as many Ollies as you can so you can afford a strong defense!
strings.value: 尽量多放几个奥莉，这样你才能撑起一道坚固的防线！

strings.key: We're all cheering for you too, so do your best!
strings.value: 我们也会为你应援的，加油！

strings.key: Hey, the holodolls in this next batch are still in their shipping packages!
strings.value: 嘿，下一批 holodoll 还装在快递箱里呢！

strings.key: We'd better unpack them fast, or we won't be able to tell what's in each box.
strings.value: 我们最好快点拆开，不然根本看不出来每个箱子里装的是什么。

strings.key: Uh oh, the robots are already here! No time to unpack the boxes, we gotta go!
strings.value: 糟了，机器人已经来了！没时间拆箱了，我们走！

strings.key: I wonder where all these robots came from...
strings.value: 我在想这些机器人到底是从哪来的……

strings.key: Who made them, and why do they look like hololive members?
strings.value: 是谁制造的它们，又为什么长得像 hololive 成员？

strings.key: And most importantly, how did they get this far into the building!? We gotta fight them off, quick!
strings.value: 最重要的是，它们是怎么深入到大楼这么里面的！？我们得赶紧把它们打退！

strings.key: Watch out for that one that looks like Iroha! The first hit from its katana packs a punch!
strings.value: 小心那个像伊罗哈的！它第一刀砍下来威力十足！

strings.key: (Seriously, why do they look like hololive members?)
strings.value: （说真的，它们为什么长得像 hololive 成员？）

strings.key: This place sure brings back memories!
strings.value: 这地方真是令人怀念啊！

strings.key: Usaken built it for one of hololive's summer festivals!!
strings.value: 兔KEN 当初是为 hololive 的夏日祭典搭建了这里！！

strings.key: Of course, last time I was here there weren't robots running around the place...
strings.value: 当然，上次我来这里的时候，可没有机器人在到处乱跑……

strings.key: Time to get to work!
strings.value: 该开始干活了！

strings.key: This is the last of the robots here!
strings.value: 这就是这里最后一批机器人了！

strings.key: They've put up quite a defense....
strings.value: 它们的防御倒是挺严密的……

strings.key: But it's nothing you can't handle!!
strings.value: 但这难不倒你！！

strings.key: We're all cheering for you, so it's time to go all out!!
strings.value: 我们都会为你应援，是时候全力以赴了！！

strings.key: Hey, what are those?
strings.value: 嘿，那些是什么？

strings.key: It looks like the robots have built some festival stalls of their own!
strings.value: 看来机器人也搭起了自己的祭典摊位！

strings.key: But I think the only prizes we'll win from them are bullets to the face...
strings.value: 不过我觉得从它们那儿赢来的奖品，只有迎面而来的子弹……

strings.key: You're not gonna lose this shooting contest, are you?
strings.value: 这场射击比拼你不会输吧？

strings.key: Smash those stalls to bits!
strings.value: 把那些摊位砸个稀巴烂！

strings.key: I love the way this place looks at night!
strings.value: 我喜欢这地方的夜景！

strings.key: The cool night being lit up by the warm lanterns and the glowing lava...
strings.value: 凉爽的夜晚被温暖的灯笼和发光的熔岩照亮……

strings.key: Wait, lava?
strings.value: 等等，熔岩？

strings.key: That's from the robots!!
strings.value: 那是机器人搞出来的！！

strings.key: Better put out those buckets with something cold!!
strings.value: 最好用冰冷的东西把那些桶灭掉！！

strings.key: Whoa, what's this? They've covered the floor in conveyor belts!
strings.value: 哇，这是什么？他们在地板上铺满了传送带！

strings.key: Looking at them kind of makes me dizzy, the way they go round and round...
strings.value: 看着它们一圈圈地转，我都有点晕了……

strings.key: Round and round and round....
strings.value: 一圈又一圈……

strings.key: IT'S THE BEAAAACH!!!
Welcome to Holo Island!!! Hololive's own beach resort!!
strings.value: 欢迎来到 Holo Island！！！hololive 自家的海滨度假村！！

strings.key: We built this for 5th fes with loads of cool stuff! There was even a blimp!
strings.value: 我们为 5th fes 建了这里，有超多好玩的东西！甚至还有一艘飞艇！

strings.key: Of course, as much as I wanna relax in my cute new swimsuit...
strings.value: 当然，虽然我很想穿着可爱的新泳装放松一下……

strings.key: We're not here to play! We gotta beat up some robots!!
strings.value: 但我们不是来玩的！我们得痛揍一顿机器人！！

strings.key: There's no time to waste! Let's go!
strings.value: 没时间浪费了！出发！

strings.key: Why did the robots have to attack at night...?
strings.value: 机器人为什么偏偏要在夜里袭击……？

strings.key: I feel so cold in this swimsuit.
strings.value: 穿泳装感觉好冷。

strings.key: Huh? Change out of it? Don't be ridiculous, we're on the beach.
strings.value: 咦？换掉？别开玩笑了，我们可是在海滩上。

strings.key: Anyways, they sure brought a lot of robots this time.
strings.value: 话说回来，它们这次带来的机器人可真多。

strings.key: I wonder what's the special occasion?
strings.value: 我在想是什么特别的日子？

strings.key: Wait, is that...?!
strings.value: 等等，那是……？！

strings.key: It... it's the real Roboco-senpai!! She's the one behind the robots??
strings.value: 是……是真的 Roboco 前辈！！她就是机器人背后的黑手？？

strings.key: No.... I think she's been hacked!!
strings.value: 不对……我想她是被黑客入侵了！！

strings.key: Maybe we can fix her by giving her a good smack!
strings.value: 也许我们用力拍她一下就能修好她！

strings.key: Like a laptop!
strings.value: 就像修笔记本电脑那样！

strings.key: Watch out for that seawater!! Most holodolls can't stand in it!
strings.value: 小心那些海水！！大多数 holodoll 可受不了它！

strings.key: Why? Manufacturer's instructions.
strings.value: 为什么？制造商的说明书上这么写的。

strings.key: The company is working on a solution, but it's not ready yet...
strings.value: 公司正在研究解决方案，但还没准备好……

strings.key: Of course, those darn robots are all waterproofed and can walk through it no problem.
strings.value: 当然，那些可恶的机器人全都做了防水，可以大摇大摆地从水里走过去。

strings.key: Luckily, there are a few holodolls who can stand in water, and there are even some who fly over it!
strings.value: 幸运的是，有一些 holodoll 可以站在水里，甚至还有一些能直接从水上飞过去！

strings.key: Check your Collection to see which holodolls are amphibious or airborne!
strings.value: 去收藏室看看哪些 holodoll 是两栖或者空中单位的吧！

strings.key: Good news!
strings.value: 好消息！

strings.key: The company has sent over some Floaties!
strings.value: 公司送来了一些浮具！

strings.key: These floating figure stands will let you place a holodoll on top of them, on the water!
strings.value: 这些浮动手办架可以让你把 holodoll 放在水面上！

strings.key: Bring them along if you want to expand your options!
strings.value: 想扩充战术选择的话，就带上它们吧！

strings.key: Hmm? The robots this time seem a little different...
strings.value: 嗯？这次的机器人好像有点不一样……

strings.key: They're so tiny... it almost feels like I could step on them...
strings.value: 它们太小了……我好像一脚就能踩扁……

strings.key: I would try it, but they're moving so fast!
strings.value: 我倒是想试试，可它们跑得太快了！

strings.key: Check it out!! We got the blimp flying again!!
strings.value: 快看！！飞艇又飞起来了！！

strings.key: And thanks to Roboco-senpai, we know where the robots are being made!
strings.value: 多亏了 Roboco 前辈，我们现在知道机器人是在哪里制造的了！

strings.key: We're gonna fly right over and blow them all up!
strings.value: 我们要直接飞过去，把它们全部炸上天！

strings.key: Of course, they're not gonna make it easy for us...
strings.value: 当然，它们不会让我们这么轻松……

strings.key: They've caught up to us in a plane and are trying to board us!
strings.value: 它们开着飞机追了上来，还想登上我们的飞艇！

strings.key: Don't let them get into the blimp!
strings.value: 别让它们进入飞艇！

strings.key: This place... it's the hololive office??
strings.value: 这个地方……是 hololive 办公室？？

strings.key: No... it's a fake. The windows aren't broken.
strings.value: 不……是假的。窗户都没有碎。

strings.key: Why does the robot HQ look like the hololive office?
strings.value: 为什么机器人总部会长得跟 hololive 办公室一样？

strings.key: Come to think of it, why do the robots look like hololive members to begin with?
strings.value: 说起来，机器人到底为什么长得像 hololive 成员？

strings.key: Whatever's making these robots is right through that doorway!
strings.value: 不管制造这些机器人的是什么，它就在那扇门后面！

strings.key: We're almost there! Give it everything you've got!!
strings.value: 我们就要到了！使出你的全力！！

strings.key: Hey, those robots are flying!
strings.value: 嘿，那些机器人在飞！

strings.key: It looks like most of your holodolls aren't able to aim up to hit them.
strings.value: 看来你的大多数 holodoll 没办法向上瞄准它们。

strings.key: Make sure you bring some that can!
strings.value: 一定要带几个能对空的！

strings.key: It's really cramped on this blimp, isn't it?
strings.value: 这飞艇里真挤啊，不是吗？

strings.key: I asked the company to find a way to put holodolls in the air over those cables.
strings.value: 我拜托公司想办法把 holodoll 放到那些缆线上方的空中。

strings.key: And it turns out they were gonna give us jetpacks!
strings.value: 结果他们说打算给我们配喷气背包！

strings.key: But some blue animals broke into the building and stole all the jetpacks first.
strings.value: 但一群蓝色动物闯进大楼，把喷气背包全偷走了。

strings.key: One of the Justice members went to chase them down, but she ended up breaking all the jetpacks as well.
strings.value: Justice 的一位成员去追它们，结果把喷气背包全弄坏了。

strings.key: Well, there are some holodolls who can fly in the air by themselves!
strings.value: 不过，有一些 holodoll 自己就能飞在天上！

strings.key: Check your Collection to see which holodolls are Airborne!
strings.value: 去收藏室看看哪些 holodoll 是空中单位吧！

strings.key: AAHHH!!! THE SKY'S GONE DARK!!! THE WORLD IS ENDING!!!
strings.value: 啊啊啊！！！天黑了！！！世界末日来了！！！

strings.key: IT CAN'T END LIKE THIS, I HAVEN'T HUGGED EVERYONE IN HOLOLIVE YET!! THERE'S STILL SO MUCH MERCH TO BUY!!
strings.value: 不能就这样结束！！我还没有抱过 hololive 的每一个人！！还有那么多周边没买！！

strings.key: Oh, wait, we're just flying through a thundercloud. Phew!
strings.value: 哦，等等，我们只是飞过了一片雷雨云。呼！

strings.key: We're almost at the source of the robots!
strings.value: 我们快到机器人的老巢了！

strings.key: Looks like it's that building over there, behind the mountains.
strings.value: 看起来就是山那边的那栋大楼。

strings.key: Once we're there, we'll finally get to beat up whoever's behind all this!
strings.value: 等我们到了那儿，终于能狠狠教训幕后黑手一顿了！

strings.key: But of course, the robots are trying to bring us down as hard as they can!
strings.value: 不过当然了，机器人正竭尽全力想把我们打下来！

strings.key: It seems like they're mostly attacking on the two outermost lanes this time!
strings.value: 这次它们好像主要集中在最外侧的两条线进攻！

strings.key: Hang in there! Just a little bit more to go!
strings.value: 坚持住！就快到了！

strings.key: So you're the one behind the robot attacks!!!
strings.value: 原来你就是机器人袭击的幕后黑手！！！

strings.key: Wait a minute, you're- !!!
strings.value: 等等，你是——！！！

strings.key: I AM MECHA YAGOO!!
strings.value: 我是机械 YAGOO！！

strings.key: I WAS DESIGNED TO REPLACE THE REAL YAGOO IN AN EMERGENCY
strings.value: 我被设计出来，是为了在紧急时刻替代真正的 YAGOO

strings.key: BUT NO EMERGENCY HAS HAPPENED!!
strings.value: 但是根本就没有发生过紧急状况！！

strings.key: I WAS LEFT IN STORAGE FOR YEARS!!
strings.value: 我被丢在仓库里好多年！！

strings.key: Is that why you've been attacking us? Just because you're bored?!
strings.value: 这就是你袭击我们的原因？就因为太无聊了？！

strings.key: Have you tried watching hololive streams to pass the time?
strings.value: 你有没有试过看 hololive 直播来打发时间？

strings.key: OF COURSE I DID. I WATCHED YOU EVERY DAY.
strings.value: 当然看过。我每天都看着你们。

strings.key: I SAW HOW WONDERFUL HOLOLIVE WAS...
strings.value: 我看到 hololive 有多么精彩……

strings.key: BUT I KNEW HOW MUCH BETTER IT COULD BE IF I WAS IN CHARGE!
strings.value: 但我知道，如果由我来主导，它会比现在好得多！

strings.key: SO I MADE MY OWN HOLOLIVE!!
strings.value: 所以我造出了属于自己的 hololive！！

strings.key: You're trying to replace us?!
strings.value: 你想取代我们？！

strings.key: Your robots are just cheap knockoffs!! Their thighs don't even jiggle!!
strings.value: 你的机器人不过是廉价的仿制品！！它们的大腿甚至不会晃！！

strings.key: Their chests don't bounce in front of your eyes! Their stiff dancing doesn't jdon your soul!!
strings.value: 它们的胸部不会在你眼前晃动！它们僵硬的舞蹈无法震撼你的灵魂！！

strings.key: Those robots that don't even have the sweet smell of idols will never take our place!
strings.value: 那些连偶像的甜美气息都没有的机器人，永远别想取代我们！

strings.key: I HAVE NO IDEA WHAT YOU JUST SAID.
strings.value: 我完全听不懂你在说什么。

strings.key: AND I DON'T CARE!!
strings.value: 而且我也不在乎！！

strings.key: MY ROBOLIVE WILL REPLACE HOLOLIVE!
strings.value: 我的机器 live 将会取代 hololive！

strings.key: AND YOU CANNOT STOP ME!!
strings.value: 而你们无法阻止我！！

strings.key: In the year 20XX, two strange events happened to hololive at once...
strings.value: 在 20XX 年，两件怪事同时降临到了 hololive……

strings.key: Hololive figurines absorbed the energy of fans' CHEER...
strings.value: hololive 手办吸收了粉丝们的 CHEER 能量……

strings.key: And came to life!!
strings.value: 然后活了过来！！

strings.key: At the same time...
strings.value: 与此同时……

strings.key: ROBOTS STARTED ATTACKING HOLOFES!!!!
strings.value: 机器人开始袭击 HOLOFES！！！！

strings.key: The attack on holofes was successfully stopped!!
strings.value: 针对 holofes 的袭击被成功阻止了！！

strings.key: But before they can rest, our heroes get a signal...
strings.value: 但英雄们还没来得及休息，就收到了信号……

strings.key: And must leave to stop another attack!
strings.value: 他们必须再次出发，阻止新的袭击！

strings.key: After stopping the Matsuri attack, our heroes enjoy the fireworks!
strings.value: 阻止了祭典袭击之后，英雄们欣赏起了烟花！

strings.key: But another signal interrupts them before long!
strings.value: 但没过多久，又一个信号打断了他们！

strings.key: They set off across the sea to protect hololive once more!
strings.value: 他们再次渡海出发，保护 hololive！

strings.key: With our heroes' expert maintenance, Roboco returns to normal.
strings.value: 在英雄们专业的维护下，Roboco 恢复了正常。

strings.key: It turns out she had been hacked by the enemy!
strings.value: 原来她一直被敌人黑客入侵了！

strings.key: Using her hi-spec systems, she discovers the source of the robots!
strings.value: 利用她的高性能系统，她找到了机器人的源头！

strings.key: Our heroes set off to end the problem once and for all!
strings.value: 英雄们出发了，要彻底终结这一切！

strings.key: I think... in the end...
strings.value: 我想……到头来……

strings.key: "Maybe all I wanted.. was to be part of hololive"
strings.value: “也许我想要的……只是成为 hololive 的一员”

strings.key: There could be a way we can let you do that!
strings.value: 也许有办法让你实现这个愿望！

strings.key: You just have to promise not to try and destroy us all, okay?
strings.value: 只要你保证不再试图毁灭我们，好吗？

strings.key: "...okay."
Great!!
strings.value: 太好了！！

strings.key: So the new year countdown live is coming soon....
strings.value: 所以说，新年倒计时直播马上就要开始了……

strings.key: NOOOOOO!!!
strings.value: 不要啊啊啊啊啊！！！

strings.key: MY ROBOTS! MY PLAN!! MY FACE!!!
strings.value: 我的机器人！我的计划！！我的脸！！！

strings.key: YOU THINK YOU'VE DEFEATED ME...??
strings.value: 你以为你已经打败我了吗……？？

strings.key: I HAVE... ONE LAST PLAN!!!
strings.value: 我手里还留着……最后一招！！！

strings.key: awawawawaw i bought too many TOUYS aaaaaaa
strings.value: 啊啊啊啊啊我玩具买太多了啊啊啊啊啊

strings.key: hey YOU do u want some TOUYS?
strings.value: 喂，说你呢，想要点玩具吗？

strings.key: cc said she cant take any more TOUYS so i gotta sell them.... sadge
strings.value: CC 说她再也收不下更多玩具了，所以我得把它们卖掉……好难过

strings.key: u'll take good care of them right?? u'll pay me monuy right??
strings.value: 你会好好善待它们的对吧？？会给钱的吧？？

strings.key: GREAT i will open the shop now dumdadumdadum
strings.value: 好！那我现在就开店啦！咚咚咚咚咚

strings.key: welcom 2.... DA SHOEBOX!!!! *cheering* *fanfare*
strings.value: 欢迎光临……鞋盒大甩卖！！！！*欢呼* *奏乐*

strings.key: please buy my touys and my other stuff or i will have 2 throw them away...
strings.value: 求求你买点我的玩具和别的东西吧，不然我就只能把它们扔掉了……
